summary.text: Luke E. Torian is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 24th District, which covers part of Prince William County, and has served since 2010.
Torian sits on the House committees on Appropriations, General Laws and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Luke E. Torian was born in Roxboro, NC, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Torian's education as Winston-Salem State University, NC (B.A., 1980); Virginia Union University, School of Theology (M.Div., 1984); Howard University, School of Divinity, Washington, DC (D.Min., 1987).
The profile gives Torian's occupation as minister/pastor.

Torian's listed memberships and affiliations include First Mount Zion Baptist Church; Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Inc.; Prince William Ministerial Association; Virginians Organized for Interfaith Community Engagement.
